around.source: CityMETER Factory rows with a published point (data/factories.json of this repository)
around.rule: straight-line distance from the point to the OpenStreetMap outline ≤ 3 km (0 inside it); a context set, never membership

demoPackage.note: Prepared bundle named in DEMO_README; read through the sheet tabs it was built from (the archive itself is larger than the Drive connector returns)

excludedFields: directory names written as a natural person's (shown as ผู้ประกอบการบุคคลธรรมดา, never sent to Google)
source_record_id and IEAT directory detail URLs per company
review notes, hold reasons by review id, candidate geometry ids other than the demo selection
geometry area (QA only in the master, not an official area)
parcel or contact data of any source
